title: Modal Particles
description: бы, ли, же, ведь, разве, неужели
descriptionRussian: Частицы бы, ли, же, ведь, разве, неужели
intro: Modal particles add subtle meanings that are essential for natural Russian. БЫ = hypothetical/conditional: Я бы пошёл (I would go). ЛИ = whether/question: Не знаю, придёт ли он (whether he'll come). ЖЕ = emphasis: Я же говорил! (I DID tell you!). ВЕДЬ = 'after all/you know': Ведь я прав? (I'm right, aren't I?). РАЗВЕ = surprised disbelief: Разве он не знает? (Doesn't he know?!). НЕУЖЕЛИ = amazed surprise: Неужели это правда? (Can this really be true?). These particles are everywhere in spoken Russian.
rules: Бы + past tense = conditional/hypothetical: Я бы сделал (I would do)
Ли = whether (indirect questions) or emphatic yes/no: Придёт ли он?
Же = emphasis, reminder: Я же сказал! (I DID say!)
Ведь = appeal to shared knowledge: Ведь ты знаешь... (You know, after all...)
examples: Я бы помог, но у меня нет времени. (I would help, but I have no time.)
Не знаю, будет ли он дома. (I don't know whether he'll be home.)
Ты же обещал! (But you promised!, emphasis)
Ведь это очевидно! (It's obvious, after all!)

items.prompt: Я _____ пошёл, но у меня нет времени. (would)
items.promptEnglish: I would go, but I have no time.
I don't know whether he will come.

items.prompt: Она говорит по-русски? Но _____ она не русская! (but she's not Russian, after all!)
items.promptEnglish: She speaks Russian? But she's not Russian, after all!
items.hint: Appealing to a known fact = ведь
items.explanation: Ведь appeals to shared knowledge: 'after all, we both know she's not Russian.'

items.prompt: _____ ты сам это сделал?! Не верю! (Can you really have done this yourself?!)
items.promptEnglish: Did you really do this yourself?! I can't believe it!
items.hint: Amazed that something positive is true = неужели
items.explanation: Неужели expresses amazed surprise at something positive: 'Can it really be that you did this yourself?!'

items.prompt: _____ ты знаешь, что он болен! (after all/you know)
items.promptEnglish: You know he's sick, after all!

items.prompt: Я _____ сказал тебе вчера! (emphasis - I DID tell you)

items.promptEnglish: If only I had known earlier...
I wonder whether she'll like the gift.

items.prompt: _____ ты уже уходишь? Мы только начали! (surprised disbelief)
items.promptEnglish: Are you really leaving already? We just started!
items.hint: Surprised that something unexpected is true = разве
items.explanation: Разве expresses surprised disbelief: the speaker can't believe someone is leaving so soon.

items.prompt: Мы _____ договорились встретиться в пять! (emphasis - we DID agree)
items.promptEnglish: We DID agree to meet at five!
items.hint: Reminding someone of a fact = же
items.explanation: Же adds emphasis, reminding the listener of something they should already know.

blanks: Он _____ помог, если бы мог. (He would have helped if he could.)
Не знаю, придёт _____ он. (I don't know whether he'll come.)
hints: Which particle creates hypothetical/conditional meaning ('would have')?
Which particle adds emphasis, like reminding someone of something?
Which particle means 'whether' in indirect questions?
explanations: Бы + past tense forms the conditional: 'Он бы помог' = 'He would have helped.'
Же adds emphasis or reminder: 'Ты же обещал!' = 'You DID promise!'
Ли creates indirect questions: 'придёт ли он' = 'whether he'll come.'

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ знал об этом. (He would have known about this.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He would have known about this.
minimalPairs.explanation: Бы creates a hypothetical/conditional meaning: 'would have known.'

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ знал об этом! (He DID know about this!)
minimalPairs.explanation: Же adds emphasis: 'He DID know!' Stressing that this is a fact.
